title: The Azzurri Camp
logline: SAMPLE. Three days as Italy: anthem, diaspora, memory of the great ships, club tension, then a name for your people's Stand.

questions.scene: Tournament night. Italian flags in a foreign square. The anthem starts.

choices.label: Sing full. Memory as volume.
Quiet hand on heart. Belonging without theatre.
Watch the faces first. Then join when it feels true.

questions.scene: Someone near you only knows Italy through clubs. Someone else only through the World Cup.
questions.prompt: Which Italy do you carry into the night?

choices.label: The tournament Italy. Flags and one summer at a time.
The club Italy. Serie A blood, every weekend.
Both. Different ships. Same fleet.

questions.scene: The square needs a name to warm the cold wait. An Italian ghost for the camp.
questions.prompt: Whose name do you give them?

choices.label: Zoff. The wall. Calm when the world shook.
Rossi. The striker who made a summer immortal.
Baggio. Beauty under pressure. The divine ponytail.

questions.scene: Your club shirt is under the jacket. Fiorentina purple. Italy blue above.
questions.prompt: If they clash this week, who speaks first?

choices.label: Italy. Nation nights rewrite the calendar.
Fiorentina. The ordinary love does not pause.
I refuse the clash. Two loves. No ranking tonight.

questions.scene: Day one ends. Name your Italy Stand for this week.

choices.label: Loud in the square. Soft in the memory.
Quiet belonging. Deep fleet.
Club and country. No clean split.

questions.cliffhanger: Tomorrow: Part 2. The catalogue continues. Pirlo, Del Piero, Cannavaro wait in the camp.

questions.scene: SAMPLE. Next GST day. A clip of Pirlo circles the chat. Control as poetry.
questions.prompt: What do you honour in an Italian midfielder?

choices.label: The pause. Seeing the pass before the pitch does.
The fight. Winning the ugly metres.
Both. Beauty without steel is a postcard.

questions.scene: Del Piero. Juventus and Italy. Someone asks if club legends can be national saints.

choices.label: Yes. The shirt above is bigger than any crest.
Only when they bled for both without choosing sides in public.
Club first in my heart. Nation first in July.

questions.scene: Cannavaro lifts an old memory of captains who spoke with their backs.
questions.prompt: What kind of Italian captain do you trust?

choices.label: The organiser. Quiet orders. Loud example.
The warrior. First into the duel.
The translator. Club egos into one camp.

questions.scene: A rival fan says Italy only wakes up for tournaments.

choices.label: Smile. Let the next match speak.
Correct them with history. Names, not noise.
Invite them to watch with you. Convert, do not conquer.

questions.scene: Day two closes. Second line for your Azzurri Stand.

choices.label: Beauty and steel. Same camp.
Captains over celebrities.
History first. Volume second.

questions.cliffhanger: Tomorrow: Part 3. Diaspora night. How Italy travels when home is far.

questions.scene: SAMPLE. You are not in Italy. The stream lags. The chat does not.
questions.prompt: How do you keep the Azzurri Stand alive from away?

choices.label: Full voice on the call. Sing like the square.
Same scarf. Same hour. Quiet ritual.
Bring a friend who has never cared. Grow the fleet.

questions.scene: A young fan asks why older names still matter when the current squad is the only pitch that counts.

choices.label: The catalogue is the map. Without it you wander.
Honour the past. Demand the present. Both.
Love who wears blue now. Memory is dessert.

questions.scene: Club football returns tomorrow. Italy fades for a while.
questions.prompt: How do you leave the camp?

choices.label: Clean switch. Purple or club colours until the next call.
Keep a thread of blue in the week. Small rituals.
No leaving. Dual citizenship of the heart.

questions.scene: One image stays: many ships, one harbour. The danger of a single story of Italy.
questions.prompt: What is Italy to you in one feeling?

choices.label: Pride that travels.
Craft under pressure.
Family argument that still sits at the same table.

questions.scene: Chapter end. The Azzurri Camp closes. Name your Stand.
questions.prompt: Who were you across these three days?

choices.label: The loud pilgrim of the square.
The catalogue keeper. Names as shelter.
The hybrid. Blue and club. No apology.

questions.cliffhanger: Chapter complete. Share your Stand. Next: another nation pack, or return to your club.
